title: Material Maker Experiments and AI Workflows
body:
I've been playing with where AI fits in an art workflow that still leaves room for hands-on craft. This little atlas is a test bed: six procedural materials made in Material Maker, then applied to familiar props so I can compare how each finish reads across different shapes.

It's a nice way to move between quick visual experiments and the slower work of tuning editable material graphs. Still exploring, but the surfaces are starting to feel like a useful palette for future scenes.

![Six-panel material atlas showing stone, plaster, green and wood finishes on simple game props including spheres, a table, a cabinet, a computer and a stool.](../media/material-atlas-2026-09-25-material-maker-ai-workflows/material-atlas.png)
